summary: Full E2E testing complete for SCALE India MVP. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests PASSED (100%) covering auth, content, theme, events, sessions, all 4 form endpoints, submissions admin gating. Frontend: All critical flows work — homepage loads with all sections, nav CTAs scroll correctly, event register modal submits, suggest-topic modal opens, SCALE+ plan toggle works, SCALE+ application and scholarship modals open and submit, contact form submits, admin login redirects to /admin and CMS dashboard tabs (Content/Events/Sessions/Theme/Submissions) render with expected action buttons. User signup redirects to / as expected, non-admin accessing /admin redirects to /login.

minor.issue: Spec says returns 'hello' but actually returns {'message': 'SCALE India API'} — acceptable but deviates from stated spec

integration_issues.issue: data-testid on trigger is 'contact-subject-trigger' but spec expected 'contact-subject'. Default value 'General Inquiry' is preselected so form still submits successfully. Minor naming drift — low priority.

issues: External logo image (customer-assets.emergentagent.com) renders as a large awkward white box with 'scALe' wordmark rather than a polished circular/brand badge. Visual presentation could be refined (sizing/framing) to match the premium feel of the rest of the site.

action_items: Optional: rename data-testid on the contact subject Select trigger from 'contact-subject-trigger' to 'contact-subject' to match the documented spec (minor).
Optional polish: frame/size the hero logo image better — it currently renders as a large white block that visually dominates the hero section.
Optional: align GET /api/ response message with documented spec if desired ('hello' vs 'SCALE India API').
critical_code_review_comments: Good: MongoDB _id is consistently excluded in all find/find_one queries via projection.
Good: All protected admin routes use a dependency (require_admin) that returns 403 — verified via tests.
Good: Passwords hashed with bcrypt, JWT auth, password stripped before returning user.
Good: Pydantic validation on every endpoint body; EmailStr enforces email format.
Good: Form endpoints save submission BEFORE attempting Brevo email (side-effect) so email failures don't break form submission (Brevo send is fire-and-forget via notify_admin).
Minor: server.py is ~544 lines and hosts all routes/models — will become unwieldy as features grow; consider splitting into routers (auth, content, events, forms).
Minor: @app.on_event('startup') / 'shutdown' are deprecated in FastAPI — consider migrating to lifespan context manager.
Minor: ADMIN_PASSWORD stored plaintext in .env and re-hashed each startup; acceptable for this seed-on-boot pattern.
Minor: Contact dropdown testid naming drift ('contact-subject-trigger' vs 'contact-subject').

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows pass; minor testid naming drift on 1 element)

test_credentials: Admin: scalesupportteam2@gmail.com / SCALEdaddySALLU67 (seeded). Test user accounts were created dynamically during testing (TEST_ prefix).
seed_data_creation: None manually — backend auto-seeds admin, content, theme, 2 events (Mock Stock Market live, Situational coming_soon), and 2 sessions on startup. Tests create & clean up their own TEST_ records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — 23 tests, all green. Reuse for regression. Admin seeded on backend startup via ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD in backend/.env. Brevo email send is fire-and-forget; form endpoints always return 200 OK regardless of email deliverability. Frontend testids: auth pages use 'auth-email'/'auth-password'/'auth-submit' (not 'login-*'); event cards use dynamic testids 'event-card-{id}', 'event-register-btn-{id}', 'event-notify-btn-{id}'; scholarship fields use 'schol-*' prefix; contact subject trigger uses 'contact-subject-trigger'.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bugs found. Full stack is functional.
